body.intent: Parallel scripts, longest first, weighted CI shards: cmd/rhiza's scripts run at a -parallel bounded by cores and memory, start longest first, and CI's script shards split by a checked-in timing file instead of round-robin by name. Evidence: scripts use ~1.2 cores at -parallel 4; at -parallel 12 they take 381 s instead of 639 s with 0 failures; CI shards took 61-239 s.
body.title: Parallel weighted scripts
